subtitle: 原創模擬題（學測風格）：經驗敘述＋心得的兩段式作文
task: Many students use their phones for several hours a day. Write an English composition of about 120–180 words in two paragraphs. In the first paragraph, describe a time when you could not use your phone for a whole day (for example, it was broken or you left it at home) and what happened that day. In the second paragraph, explain what you learned from the experience.
taskZh: 許多學生每天花好幾個小時用手機。請寫一篇約 120–180 字、兩段的英文作文。第一段描述某次你一整天無法使用手機的經驗（例如手機壞了或忘在家裡）以及那天發生的事；第二段說明你從這次經驗學到什麼。
focus: 內容：第一段有具體經過，第二段有真實的體會
組織：兩段分工清楚，時間順序連貫
文法句構：過去式、過去完成式與現在完成式使用正確
字彙拼字：用字精確、拼字正確

en: Last spring, I dropped my phone into a bowl of beef noodle soup, and it stopped working immediately. Since the repair shop needed a full day to fix it, I had to spend Sunday without it. At first, I felt nervous and kept reaching into my pocket out of habit. Without my map app, I even got lost on my way to the library. Later that afternoon, however, I borrowed two novels and read one of them from cover to cover, something I had not done in years.

This experience taught me that my phone had been taking more of my time than I realized. Without notifications interrupting me every few minutes, I could focus for hours and actually enjoy it. Since then, I have kept my phone in another room while I study and turned off notifications from most apps. I still use my phone every day, but now I try to decide when to use it instead of letting it decide for me.
zh: 去年春天，我把手機掉進一碗牛肉麵裡，它當場就壞了。因為維修行需要一整天才能修好，我只好過一個沒有手機的星期天。一開始，我很焦慮，還會習慣性地把手伸進口袋。沒有地圖 App，我甚至在去圖書館的路上迷路了。不過，那天下午稍晚，我借了兩本小說，還把其中一本從頭到尾讀完，這是我好幾年沒做過的事。
這次經驗讓我明白，手機佔用我的時間比我以為的還多。沒有每隔幾分鐘就跳出來的通知打擾，我可以專心好幾個小時，而且真的樂在其中。從那之後，我讀書時都把手機放在另一個房間，並關掉大部分 App 的通知。我還是每天用手機，但現在我試著自己決定什麼時候用，而不是讓手機替我決定。

patterns.zh: 描述一開始的反應：出於習慣地……
patterns.example: At first, I felt nervous and kept reaching into my pocket out of habit.

patterns.pattern: …, something I had not done in years.
patterns.zh: 用同位語補充說明這件事的特別之處
patterns.example: Later that afternoon, however, I borrowed two novels and read one of them from cover to cover, something I had not done in years.

patterns.zh: 寫出心得：這次經驗讓我明白……
patterns.example: This experience taught me that my phone had been taking more of my time than I realized.

patterns.zh: 用現在完成式說明之後的改變
patterns.example: Since then, I have kept my phone in another room while I study and turned off notifications from most apps.

patterns.zh: 而不是讓……（對比兩種做法）
patterns.example: I still use my phone every day, but now I try to decide when to use it instead of letting it decide for me.

parts: The repair shop needed a full day to fix it.
I had to spend Sunday without it.
combine.answer: Since the repair shop needed a full day to fix it, I had to spend Sunday without it.

parts: I read one of them from cover to cover.
combine.answer: I borrowed two novels and read one of them from cover to cover.
